notes: Independent critic of the saved C5 checkout; no production art or compose.py was edited. Read BRIEF-17 in full, both panel briefs, all twenty cycle-5 fixes, the relevant NOTES method sections and critic-r17E-4. Reviewed all 101 new PNG exports at exact 1x and nearest-neighbour 4x on critic-r17C5-1-assets-01..10.png, with 8x join/door/crop details where useful. Reviewed final native/squint images, exact zoom crops and the saved 2x/3x derivatives; verified their pixels and literal comparison-panel placements independently. All eight used ground receivers were examined in literal 3x3 repeats, with native/4x proofs; retained props were inspected over summer workyard/paving. No seasonal assets are introduced in C5, so seasonal-ground and summer/winter partner tests are not applicable. All 34 red/slate/brown alpha comparisons are exactly identical. All 101 export dimensions match the delivery manifest; every export has only alpha 0/255 and zero RGB under transparency. All new facade course rows 0/47 match the established donor. Independently replayed all 14,106,624 registered mode samples with no mismatch and confirmed source hashes. These technical passes do not fix the visible splice/tile/layout failures. Storey histogram independently counted from 38 modular house/shop/rear stacks: 1=4, 2=8, 3=12, 4=10, 5=4 (10.53% one-storey). The independently counted inclusive ancillary total is 46: 1=11, 2=9, 3=12, 4=10, 5=4 (23.91%). No frontage grass was observed. Roof mix is 18 terracotta, 12 slate, 8 brown (47.37% terracotta). The existing resolved-piece audit passes the final and the retained E L-block/market/height layouts, and direct code inspection confirms E no longer forces one ground onto all eight trade shops. The new C5 L/T acceptance layout independently fails with three identical hip caps in its first five lots; it is outside that audit. FIXES disposition: 1 partial/fail (complete caps improved, fill/splice failures); 2 partial/fail (lots cleaned, wall joins not); 3 partial/fail (continuous return but unproved slope/flashing); 4 fail (material scales and facade consistency); 5 fail (property/yard registration and missing closures); 6 fail (inhabited side edges and bounded geometry incomplete); 7 substantially addressed (notched populated square, six stalls, hall south, church west, guildhall north, inn east); 8 fail (public porch scale/contact); 9 fail (framed paving and route hierarchy); 10 fail (caster geometry despite valid union/opacity); 11 fail (masonry courses and contacts); 12 substantially addressed (all eight trade symbols are nameable, recessed sign bays replace blank billboards); 13 partial/fail (new goods provided, cobbler unreadable); 14 fail (inn interaction cue); 15 partial/fail (mixed forms/heights, but cropped modules and proof repetition); 16 partial/fail (three vendors used twice, cart/porter/seated visitor/guard present, stationary route occupancy remains); 17 substantially addressed (lower southern houses, sheds and warm forge); 18 partial/fail (bench/shrine destinations provided, guard notice substituted with religious shrine and enclosure weak); 19 partial/fail (access stair/gate groove present, toll scale and wall contacts fail); 20 fail (proof repetition and incomplete compatible-join/access evidence). BRIEF-17 takes precedence over the panels: this review does not require shrinking the double-scale signs, increasing the gate footprint, deepening principal lots, allowing cross-lot overlays or waiving the eight-cell street rule. The coordinator 40x30 native-cell requirement justifies 1920x1440 rather than the earlier approximate 1200x900. No runtime collision/pathfinding result is claimed. Required next pass: fix roof fillers and shortened caps, remove ground tile frames, rebuild actual property/side-street enclosure, correct wall/door/shadow joins and audit every new acceptance scene. Verdict is fail even though source processing, height mix, palette silhouette preservation and earlier E corrections pass.
